title: Overpriced for the Quality
text:
Overpriced for the Quality. Disappointed with the quality of this product. It looks OK. If I had paid 10 bucks for it I would be happy. Its cool to look at but it is over priced for the quality of the sand and frame. The frame is cheap gray plastic and the black and white sand are already barely distinguishable and it is brand new.
Looks like a cheap kids toy.

product_metadata.title: Austrian KB Collection Sand Picture Screen Grey
features: Mysterious art created by Kraus Besh in Austria by sand, water and air. Create a different art every time you flip it over
Product Size (W x D x H): 6.3 x 4.3 x 0.3 inches (160 x 110 x 8 mm)
description: This is a sand picture made in Austria by Kraus Besh. What is Sand Picture?: This artwork allows you to draw a variety of pictures by moving freely between two sealed glass plates, such as water, air, and specific gravity. When the picture is upsided, the sand begins to fall off, drawing a variety of scenes like a sand dune or mountain. It also has a 3D effect, so you can enjoy a different expression every time. The sand drop speed is determined by the amount of air in the frame, and the included injector can be used to inflate and exit the speed of the sand. Enjoy the world of sand art in the first party that creates a completely different picture every time you flip it over.
